newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle trade at $64--feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle trade at $64--feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle actively traded $2.00 higher at $64.00 per cwt late Tuesday, feedlot sources said, and Texas feedlot sources reported $64.00 trades early Wednesday.
Kansas feedlot sources said a few packers were bidding $64.00 there early Wednesday but feedlot managers were considering the bids.
The bids of $64.00 surfaced late Tuesday afternoon and some Texas feedlot sources estimated about 15,000 head have traded at that level.
One Texas feedlot manager said a major packer lowered bids to $63.50 Wednesday.
At $64.00 feedlots were netting about a $10 loss per head, sources said.
